text:
Maya: seeing a burst of 503s from apiserver in us-west-2 for ~20m, controller-manager leader flips a few times and reconciles pile up. spike aligns with a large GPU attach wave from batch jobs. stack traces attached to incident ticket.

Liam: can you paste the apiserver logs around the first 503s? any tcp resets or proxy errors?

Maya: pastebin: https://paste.redwood/abcd1234 - short tail: 
```
I0320 12:03:14.123] http: TLS handshake error from 10.3.4.5: short record
I0320 12:03:14.456] 503 POST /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods/... 0.003s
I0320 12:04:00.001] dial tcp 10.3.4.10:2379: i/o timeout
```

sre-bot: alert: controlplane-apiserver-usw2 high 5xx rate (5m avg 12.3%), leader-election churn detected for controller-manager (3 flips).

Arjun: hypothesis: NAT port exhaustion in the us-west NAT gateway + asymmetric NAT causing some controlplane->etcd requests to timeout and trigger leader election. we've seen similar with attach bursts causing ephemeral high-conn counts.

Cassie: interesting — but the failure mode here looks like connection-level TLS handshakes failing too. Could be a proxy (envoy/ingress) hitting fd limit or a splice with MTU. any signs of SNAT port metrics spiking?

Liam: checked VPC flow logs and NAT metrics: SNAT ports used jumped from 80% -> 99% exactly at 12:02. NAT gateway logs show many ephemeral ports in TIME_WAIT. Also noticed long tails on kubelets opening watches to the apiserver, lots of new source ports.

Maya: guess: controller-manager runs many retries and watch reconnect storms when etcd RPCs fail which multiplies request fanout to apiserver because controllers requeue. End result: apiserver queues, some TLS handshakes get dropped -> 503s.

Arjun: mitigation plan I applied at 12:10: 1) scaled controller-manager from 2 -> 1 (force single leader, reduce flapping) 2) bumped kube-proxy conn-reuse and adjusted apiserver keepalive 3) provisioned a NAT gateway with larger port pool in the subnet as temporary (spin up a second NAT with SNAT translation).

Cassie: did you also throttle the GPU attach daemonset? that attach wave is the trigger, if we can smooth attaches we avoid rehitting the NAT.

Maya: yes, I added a short circuit in the GPU attach job (backoff jitter) and lowered parallelism from 50 -> 10. also added a canary pool that uses a private subnet (no NAT) for immediate attaches.

Liam: commands run for triage:
```
# check NAT port usage
aws ec2 get-nat-gateway-metrics --nat-id nat-012345 --metric "AllocatedPorts" --start 2026-03-20T11:50:00Z --end 2026-03-20T12:20:00Z

# apiserver fd count
kubectl -n kube-system exec -it apiserver-0 -- ss -s; ps aux | grep apiserver
```

Arjun: also enabled prefix KV caching in the serving clusters (non-prod) to reduce watch payloads and reduce pressure on apiserver. not a quick fix for this incident but good long-term.

sre-bot: action: incident created INC-2026-3375, severity P2. responders: @Maya @Liam @Arjun.

Maya: after actions, 503s dropped to <1% by 12:28, leader flips stopped. apiserver p99 latency back to normal by 12:33. controller-manager queue size reduced to baseline.

Cassie: follow-ups:
- increase NAT capacity for usw2 critical subnets (ops request submitted)
- add SNAT port saturation alert at 70% for controlplane-heavy clusters
- introduce attach smoothing policy in fleet-autoscaler and batch job controller
- look at enabling connection multiplexing in our controlplane proxies

Liam: cost note: spun up extra NAT (t3-nat medium) + canary private pool with smaller GPU nodes — estimated incremental cost ~ $1.2k for the day. filing chargeback to infra-budget.

Maya: filing a short RCA doc in confluence: https://confluence.redwood/infr/INC-2026-3375-rca. Will include the timeline + mitigation steps + runbook updates for attach storms.

Arjun: long-term work: we should evaluate per-cluster SNAT alternatives (EIPs per node, cross-zone private routing) and better backpressure in controllers so a transient etcd hiccup doesn't amplify to apiserver overload.

Cassie: adding a follow-up task: modify controller-manager retry policy and add max-reconcile-rate flag experimentation.

Maya: closing thread when RCA posted. thanks all :thumbsup:
